title: Curriculum: CV and cover letter
_note: business-italian run, 2026-11-15: written by hand for Italy, not yet read by a human. People, companies, email and phone number in the models are invented. CV conventions are general orientation; see the 'to verify' list in the run report.
intro: In Italy a CV is called curriculum vitae, or just CV. Many employers accept the Europass format, but a clear, own layout is also fine. A CV is usually one or two pages, in reverse order (latest job first), and normally ends with a line giving permission to process your personal data. A photo is not required (to verify for each employer). This unit gives you the headings, the phrases for describing your work, and the parts of a cover letter (lettera di presentazione).
introEasy: Do you need a CV for a job in Italy? Learn the headings and the sentences for your CV and your letter.

models.title: A CV for home care work
models.text:
Amina Rahimi
Via Garibaldi 12, 40123 Bologna
Telefono: 333 000 0123 · Email: amina.rahimi@example.org

ESPERIENZA LAVORATIVA
2021–2024 · Assistente familiare, Cooperativa Sociale Aurora, Bologna
– Assistenza agli anziani a domicilio (igiene, pasti, accompagnamento a visite mediche)
– Rapporti con le famiglie e con il medico di base

ISTRUZIONE E FORMAZIONE
2023 · Corso per assistenti familiari (120 ore), Regione Emilia-Romagna
2015 · Diploma di scuola superiore, Teheran (riconosciuto in Italia)

COMPETENZE LINGUISTICHE
Italiano B2 · Inglese B1 · Persiano madrelingua

ALTRO
Patente B. Disponibile su turni e nei fine settimana.

Autorizzo il trattamento dei dati personali ai sensi del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR).
notes: Italian CVs list the latest job first. Dates come before the job: 2021–2024.
Verbs on a CV are often noun-like or in the infinitive: Assistenza agli anziani… Full sentences are not needed.
Assistente familiare (a carer for old people at home) is the same word for men and women; only the article changes: il/la assistente.

The last line is the privacy authorisation. Many employers expect it. Whether a photo, date of birth or marital status is expected varies by employer and sector (to verify); you are not obliged to add a photo.
Levels are given in CEFR terms (B2). You can add the name and the year of the certificate.

models.title: A cover letter as an email
models.text:
Oggetto: Candidatura per la posizione di cuoco

Gentile Signora Conti,

ho letto il Vostro annuncio per un cuoco e Vi invio la mia candidatura.

Ho cinque anni di esperienza nella ristorazione, due dei quali come cuoco di linea in un ristorante di Napoli. Conosco le norme di igiene e ho il corso HACCP. Sono una persona precisa e affidabile e lavoro volentieri in squadra. Parlo italiano a livello B2.

Sarei lieto di approfondire la mia candidatura in un colloquio. In allegato trovate il mio curriculum vitae.

Nell'attesa di un Vostro riscontro, porgo cordiali saluti.

Omar Said
Tel. 333 000 0456
notes: A cover letter is short, usually five or six lines in an email. It does not repeat the whole CV.
In writing to a company, Vi/Vostro with a capital letter is traditional (plural, for the firm). With one named person you write Lei, Le, Suo.
Il corso HACCP is the food-hygiene training for kitchen staff. Mention certificates that the job needs.
End with a concrete step (un colloquio), then thank them and close.

tips: Keep your CV truthful and short: one page for a first job, two pages at most. Put contact details at the top and make sure the email address looks serious.
The Europass format is widely known and free on the European Europass site. Many employers accept your own layout as well. Ask or check the job advert.
Add the privacy line («Autorizzo il trattamento dei dati personali…») at the end. Without it some employers cannot keep your CV on file.

Name your level of Italian in CEFR terms and name the certificate if you have one. If a diploma was earned abroad, say whether it has been recognised in Italy (dichiarazione di valore or equipollenza; to verify the exact procedure for your case).

exercises.prompt: Sono una persona ___ e lavoro volentieri in squadra.
exercises.explain: Affidabile is the adjective for reliable. Affidamento is a noun.

exercises.prompt: Ho letto con interesse il Vostro ___.
exercises.explain: Annuncio is the normal word for a job advertisement. Notizia means news item.

exercises.context: In a letter or an interview.
exercises.explain: A finished period with clear dates takes the passato prossimo.

exercises.prompt: Mi ___ della contabilità e dei rapporti con i fornitori.
exercises.explain: Occuparsi di: mi occupo di (I am in charge of).
Trattamento dei dati is the legal term used on forms.
Riscontro is masculine, so gradito agrees with it.

exercises.prompt: Sarei ___ di approfondire la mia candidatura in un colloquio.
exercises.explain: Sarei lieto (a woman: lieta) is the formal way to say I would be glad.
Before a month, since is da without an article: da gennaio 2022. Before a year or a day you use dal: dal 2022, dal 3 gennaio.
A tempo determinato is a fixed-term contract (compare: a tempo indeterminato).
On a CV, scritto e parlato is the fixed pair for written and spoken.
